_why: Hand corrections to extracted question TEXT, each one read off the commission's own printed page at high resolution and recorded here rather than edited into the bank silently. Same principle as VERIFIED_KEYS.json: if a human overrode the machine, the override should be visible, attributable to a source page, and re-appliable after any re-extraction.
_how: apply_text_corrections.py matches on (source_pdf, number) and replaces only the named field.
